exposure: initiation of breastfeeding within one hour after birth
initiation and Exclusive Breast Feeding (EBF) practices
cohort: 400 lactating mother infant pairs in Dera Ghazi Khan
finding: Breast feeding practices in Dera Ghazi Khan were not optimal, with only 12% of mothers exclusively breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with initiation of breastfeeding within one hour after birth.
